answer:
The first spacewalk ever performed was Alexei Leonov’s extravehicular activity on 18 March 1965 aboard the Soviet spacecraft **Voskhod 2**.  
The commander of that mission was **Pavel Belyayev** (Soviet Air Force Lt. Col.). He led the crew while Leonov executed the EVA.
